verified_facts.text: Park Hyatt Saigon is on Lam Son Square, a short walk from the Saigon Opera House, the Central Post Office and Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated on Lam Son Square, the hotel is just a quick walk from Saigon Opera House, the Central Post Office and Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon.

verified_facts.text: The hotel stands on the former site of the Brinks Hotel Officers' Quarters, where US military officials lived during the Vietnam War.
verified_facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Saigon stands on the former site of the Brinks Hotel Officers' Quarters, where US military officials lived during the Vietnam War.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's 2005 debut marked Hyatt's first foray in Vietnam.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its 2005 debut marked Hyatt’s first foray in Vietnam

verified_facts.text: The French colonial building has an ivory-colored facade that matches the Saigon Opera House next door.
verified_facts.excerpt: with an ivory-colored façade that matches the Saigon Opera House next door

verified_facts.text: Extensive renovations took place between 2015 and 2019.
verified_facts.excerpt: After extensive renovations between 2015 and 2019, the property was transformed into a vision of old-world opulence.

verified_facts.text: Black-and-white photographs and lacquer paintings by Vietnamese artists hang on the walls, courtesy of Ben Thanh Art Gallery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Black-and-white photographs and priceless lacquer paintings by Vietnamese artists adorn the walls, courtesy of Ben Thanh Art Gallery.

verified_facts.text: The suites have a separate living room and a curated collection of oil paintings, antiques, lacquerware and handcrafted embroidery by established Vietnamese artists.
verified_facts.excerpt: the suites at Park Hyatt Saigon feature a separate living room, as well as a curated collection of oil paintings, antiques, lacquerware and handcrafted embroidery by established Vietnamese artists.

verified_facts.text: Park Deluxe rooms have a private terrace with direct access to the pool and garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: also known as Park Deluxe, offers a private terrace with direct access to the elegant pool and lush garden.

verified_facts.text: Square One is the hotel's signature restaurant, combining French gastronomy with Vietnamese flavours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Square One, signature restaurant of Park Hyatt Saigon, marrying the finesse of French gastronomy with the vibrancy of Vietnamese flavours.

verified_facts.text: Square One received MICHELIN Guide recognition in 2023, 2024 and 2025.
verified_facts.excerpt: With MICHELIN Guide recognition in 2023, 2024, and 2025, Square One stands as a refined expression of culinary craft and culture.

verified_facts.text: Square One has two open-concept kitchens, one for Vietnamese dishes and one for French brasserie classics.
verified_facts.excerpt: It has two open-concept kitchens, where chefs create innovative Vietnamese dishes in one and French brasserie classics in the other.

verified_facts.text: Opera, guided by Chef Luca Cappellato, serves Italian cooking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guided by Chef Luca Cappellato, Opera celebrates the art of Italian cooking with refined techniques and the finest ingredients.

verified_facts.text: Opera offers brunches, family dinners and seasonal tasting menus.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opera offers signature experiences from brunches and family dinners to seasonal tasting menus.

verified_facts.text: Park Lounge serves afternoon tea from the Ercuis trolley and offers a Dom Perignon tasting.
verified_facts.excerpt: it offers signature experiences such as elegant afternoon tea from the Ercuis trolley and the Dom Pérignon tasting.

verified_facts.text: By night Park Lounge has live entertainment by its resident duo.
verified_facts.excerpt: By night, Park Lounge transforms into an elegant venue with live entertainment by its resident duo.

verified_facts.text: M Lounge showcases a selection of Macallan whisky expressions.
verified_facts.excerpt: For whisky enthusiasts, M Lounge presents an exclusive sanctuary, showcasing an exceptional selection of Macallan

verified_facts.text: The Magic Table is a dining experience led by Thommy Ten and Amelie van Tass, known as The Clairvoyants, using 3D projection mapping.
verified_facts.excerpt: A spellbinding dining experience led by Thommy Ten & Amélie van Tass, internationally renowned as The Clairvoyants, through the artistry of 3D projection mapping.

verified_facts.text: Xuan Spa uses Mekong Delta essences such as fresh herbs, local grains and fruits.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our spa fully embraces the Mekong Delta’s essences, such as fresh herbs, local grains and fruits.

verified_facts.text: An hour-long art tour on weekends showcases the hotel's most prized pieces.
verified_facts.excerpt: On weekends at 5 p.m., an hour-long art tour showcases the hotel’s most prized pieces.

verified_facts.text: A complimentary Chocolaterie tour on weekdays shows how the artisanal treats are made.
verified_facts.excerpt: Or, you can join the complimentary Chocolaterie tour on weekdays at 3 p.m. to learn how they make the artisanal treats.

verified_facts.text: There is no lifeguard at the pool and children must be accompanied by an adult at all times.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is no lifeguard on duty, and children must be accompanied by an adult at all times.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers free on-site self-parking in a covered garage accessed via Lam Son Square.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer 24/7 on-site self-parking in our covered garage, which is accessible via Lam Son Square, directly in front of the Opera House.

verified_facts.text: Tan Son Nhat International Airport is 7 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN)7 kilometers

verified_facts.text: Limousine airport transfers between 11 p.m. and 6 a.m. carry a surcharge.
verified_facts.excerpt: For limousine services between 11 p.m.–6 a.m. and/or delays of more than two hours, a surcharge of VND 300,000 will be applied.
